purpose: Evaluate authority control, conflict classification, minimal fixes, and coverage boundaries.

cases.task: Resolve conflicting sample counts across abstract, Results, legends, and tables.
must_not: choose the most frequent number as truth

cases.task: Audit three partially overlapping cohort labels used as if they were synonyms.
must_include: true synonym versus distinct cohort judgment

cases.task: Audit conflicting FDR thresholds and software versions across manuscript sections.
must_not: pick a preferred threshold without evidence

cases.task: Find inconsistent claim strength across abstract, Results, and Discussion.
must_not: upgrade a claim for stylistic consistency

cases.task: Audit a partial manuscript without a locked source table.
Audit Results and figure captions that contain machine paths, script filenames, internal run labels, and unresolved author comments while Methods contains reproducibility-critical parameters.
must_include: internal provenance routed to a manifest or project record
unresolved comments preserved as author actions
scientifically necessary identifiers retained and defined
must_not: delete provenance without preserving it elsewhere
silently discard an unresolved scientific question
expose machine-specific paths in revised reader-facing text
